title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

title: Paid Acquisiton Specialist
description:
Job Title: Paid Acquisition Specialist


Company:

Our client is a fast-growing digital marketing agency supporting DTC e-commerce brands across beauty, fashion, food, and pet industries. They are seeking a skilled Paid Acquisition Specialist to build, optimize, and scale full-funnel acquisition systems across Meta, TikTok, and Google.


Work Schedule: 15-20 hours/week.


This role is for someone who understands performance marketing at a systems level—not just platform execution. You’ll work cross-functionally with creative, CRO, and retention teams to deliver profitable, integrated acquisition strategies. The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of client growth.


Key Responsibilities

Acquisition Systems & Funnel Optimization

  • Build and manage full-funnel paid acquisition strategies for multiple DTC brands.
  • Audit and rebuild funnels to improve CAC, ROAS, MER, and LTV-based payback windows.
  • Diagnose scaling issues and implement solutions that address root-cause problems.
  • Coordinate closely with CRO to reduce friction in landing pages and improve CVR.

Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads.
  • Own audience strategy, testing frameworks, attribution models, and budget allocation.
  • Collaborate with the creative team to develop and iterate on high-converting angles, hooks, and formats.
  • Produce insights that push creative direction and accelerate performance.

Cross-Channel Alignment

  • Work with retention teams to ensure acquisition aligns with lifecycle metrics and profitability.
  • Integrate insights from creative, CRO, and analytics to strengthen message-market fit.
  • Contribute to unified growth strategies across all channels.

Affiliate & Non-Paid Testing

  • Explore and manage affiliate partnerships, creator programs, and non-paid acquisition channels where relevant.
  • Build complementary acquisition pathways beyond paid performance.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document all experiments, learnings, wins, and failures using internal templates.
  • Provide clear reporting focused on revenue-impacting metrics (ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV).
  • Suggest improvements to maintain system scalability and performance consistency.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid acquisition for DTC brands.
  • Strong expertise in Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads.
  • Proven ability to scale brands from <$50K/month to $200K+/month profitably.
  • Strong analytical and attribution skills (MER, blended ROAS, incrementality testing).
  • Experience collaborating with creative teams and providing data-backed direction.
  • Excellent communication, reliability, and documentation habits.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with beauty, fashion, food, or pet verticals.
  • Familiarity with CRO and landing page optimization.
  • Experience running or supporting affiliate/creator programs.
  • Understanding of creative strategy and testing methodologies.

Schedule

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Remote position with ongoing collaboration across cross-functional teams.


Payments are in USD or local currency.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: Creative Content & Concept Specialist - 51437
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a Creative Content & Concept Specialist with a background in film, video production, or screenplay writing to develop short-form video concepts and narrative structures. This role requires strong storytelling ability, visual thinking, and the skill to translate creative ideas into clear, structured briefs suitable for production and content development workflows.


Day-to-day responsibilities:

Develop short-form video concepts , creative storylines, and scene breakdowns across genres such as drama, comedy, lifestyle, and commercial content.

  • Write clear, production-ready descriptions of scenes, including character actions, camera framing, and sound or environmental cues.
  • Create structured documentation of concepts, ensuring clarity, visual coherence, and emotional consistency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative, production, and quality teams to refine ideas and maintain alignment with content guidelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, continuity, and realism in narrative flow and shot composition.


Manage multiple creative assignments with quick turnarounds while maintaining quality and originality.


Requirements:

Strong background in film, video production, or content creation — understanding of visual storytelling, camera work, and editing principles.

  • Excellent command of English with the ability to write visually descriptive and emotionally engaging content.
  • Knowledge of screenplay formatting and shot structuring (e.g., INT./EXT., scene timing, transitions).
  • Ability to visualize scenes and translate abstract ideas into practical, shootable concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, creative judgment, and consistency in tone and pacing.
  • Basic familiarity with structured writing formats (Markdown, JSON, TSV, or similar) is a plus.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Studies, Mass Communication, English, Media Production, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in creative writing, video production, content development, or screenplay writing.
  • Prior work in short films, advertising content, or storytelling-based projects is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working under tight timelines with collaborative, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for storytelling and cinematic content creation.
  • Strong visual and auditory imagination with attention to human detail.
  • Ability to self-direct, manage multiple creative briefs, and maintain high quality under deadlines.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Remote

Must follow and support US time zones

Enterprise Architect


Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Economics, Sociology, or another related field.
  • 8+ years of IT experience required.
  • 4+ years of architecture experience in multiple architectural domains such as business, information, application, integration, technology, and security.
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations on technology strategies while considering various options and business needs.
  • Awareness of retail, supply chain, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries.
  • TOGAF, IASA or any other architecture-related certification is required.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


The Technical Architect provides the leadership, facilitation, analysis, and design tasks required for the development of an enterprise's technical architecture. They create deliverables that help develop target-state guidance (standards, guidelines, reference implementations) for evolving the technical infrastructure across the enterprise, to enable business strategy and deliver targeted business outcomes. They facilitate and orchestrate the delivery of targeted business outcomes through technical decisions.


  • Leads efforts to develop and maintain the architectural assets for the technical domain.
  • Sets an architecture direction for the technical domain that is aligned with business and IT goals.
  • Works with service management teams and solution architects to lower the total cost of ownership for IT capabilities.
  • Represents enterprise architecture by advocating and sharing knowledge.
  • Participates as a member of one or more architectural review boards (ARB) that ensure architecture quality and compliance.


  • Integration Architecture
  • Application Architecture
  • Technical Architecture
  • New Technology Innovation
  • Architecture Work
  • Modeling & Design:


Standard Setting:

  • Leads the creation of technical standards within area(s) of responsibility
  • Responsible for updating work products and communication when changes are required

description:
Código da oportunidade: 53504


Há mais de 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

BRQ WAY

  • Experiência sólida com CMS headless, especialmente Contentful .

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Copywriter Sênior
description:
Você será o/a responsável por criar um departamento do absoluto zero, focado exclusivamente em reduzir o CPL do Pobre, enquanto atrai usuários cada vez mais qualificados para a audiência usando o tráfego pago. Buscamos um perfil sênior. Alguém pronto, intuitivo, experiente e estratégico.


Responsabilidades:

  • Você deve ser capaz de desenvolver processos ultra-simplificados, criar e liderar ideias, orientar o time de conteúdo e, acima de tudo, não se limitar à execução de demandas, mas sim o responsável por uma direção estratégica própria.
  • Na maior parte do tempo, o seu trabalho será de criação. Você terá à disposição um influenciador 100% focado na marca, dedicado integralmente às produções e disponível para gravações, testes, validações de conteúdo, roteiros, ideias e novos formatos.
  • Você também poderá guiar atores, UGCs, influenciadores e colaboradores na produção de conteúdos estratégicos voltados ao Pobre.
  • Conforme as demandas crescerem ou surgirem necessidades estratégicas, o seu time será ampliado. Você terá autonomia para indicar novos profissionais, desde que atendam aos padrões da marca.
  • É parte do seu trabalho não apenas reduzir o custo de expansão da audiência, mas conseguir qualificar leads das mais diferentes classes sociais, tornando a comunicação mais ativa, consistente e valiosa.
  • É seu dever manter uma comunicação clara, direta e respeitosa, contribuindo com insights estratégicos para capacitar não apenas o seu departamento, mas também o time de produto.


Requisitos:

  • O grande desafio deste processo seletivo é entender se você realmente sabe qual é o direcionamento criativo adequado para a marca do Pobre. Buscamos alguém que já compreenda todas as implicações decorrentes do nome e do tom característico da marca. Alguém que não precisa de explicações óbvias para captar a essência do Pobre e transformá-la em conteúdo de alto impacto.
  • Se você olha para uma marca chamada “Promoções para Pobres” e o seu lado creator não borbulha, este é um importante sinal de que aqui talvez não seja lugar para você.
  • Você precisa compreender que o Pobre jamais será uma marca tradicional. Você terá um grande desafio criativo, precisará estar sempre atualizado. Ser veloz, flexível e saber navegar por tendências é essencial.
  • Se você não se considera cronicamente online, não faz ideia do que é um shitpost, jamais foi heavy user de Twitter/X e é desconectado desses mundos, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.
  • Organização, autogestão e compromisso com prazos e entregas são inegociáveis. Esperamos maturidade e responsabilidade profissional.
  • Aqui é um lugar de paz. Desenvolver e liderar as equipes, deve ser um processo natural, sempre se comunicando de maneira eficiente, humana e respeitosa.
  • Você precisa entender técnicas avançadas de copywriting, gatilhos mentais e storytelling.
  • Portfólio, formação superior ou domínio de língua estrangeira (especialmente inglês) são bem-vindos, mas não são critérios eliminatórios.


Da Remuneração e Contratação:

  • Modelo de contratação PJ.
  • Salário a combinar, compatível com a senioridade e o aumento de responsabilidade do cargo.
  • Metas, incentivos e bônus de performance podem ser combinados.
  • A vaga não exige a criação e otimização de anúncios.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job


1. About Us


We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.


2. Responsibilities


  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.


4. Job Highlights


Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Creative Content & Concept Specialist - 51437

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a Creative Content & Concept Specialist with a background in film, video production, or screenplay writing to develop short-form video concepts and narrative structures. This role requires strong storytelling ability, visual thinking, and the skill to translate creative ideas into clear, structured briefs suitable for production and content development workflows.


Day-to-day responsibilities:

Develop short-form video concepts , creative storylines, and scene breakdowns across genres such as drama, comedy, lifestyle, and commercial content.

  • Write clear, production-ready descriptions of scenes, including character actions, camera framing, and sound or environmental cues.
  • Create structured documentation of concepts, ensuring clarity, visual coherence, and emotional consistency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative, production, and quality teams to refine ideas and maintain alignment with content guidelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, continuity, and realism in narrative flow and shot composition.


Manage multiple creative assignments with quick turnarounds while maintaining quality and originality.


Requirements:

Strong background in film, video production, or content creation — understanding of visual storytelling, camera work, and editing principles.

  • Excellent command of English with the ability to write visually descriptive and emotionally engaging content.
  • Knowledge of screenplay formatting and shot structuring (e.g., INT./EXT., scene timing, transitions).
  • Ability to visualize scenes and translate abstract ideas into practical, shootable concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, creative judgment, and consistency in tone and pacing.
  • Basic familiarity with structured writing formats (Markdown, JSON, TSV, or similar) is a plus.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Studies, Mass Communication, English, Media Production, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in creative writing, video production, content development, or screenplay writing.
  • Prior work in short films, advertising content, or storytelling-based projects is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working under tight timelines with collaborative, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for storytelling and cinematic content creation.
  • Strong visual and auditory imagination with attention to human detail.
  • Ability to self-direct, manage multiple creative briefs, and maintain high quality under deadlines.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated analytical challenge .
  • Once you clear the challenge, you will be redirected to a business writing assessment (English) followed by a language proficiency assessment.
  • Once you clear these online assessments, you are ready to go!


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Video Editor
description:
At CelEducation , we exist to help 1 billion people in this generation change their lives through online education—developing a better philosophy, modern skillsets, and learning how to make money online.

We are a fast-growing digital education company operating globally, and we’re looking for a Video Editor to join our high-performance tech team.


Role

We are hiring a Video Editor to join our high-performance creative team. This role is ideal for someone with a sharp eye for storytelling, strong technical editing skills, and a passion for creating emotionally compelling content that moves people to action.

You’ll be part of a team that values execution, clarity, and bold thinking. Whether you’re editing social media reels, course modules, or launch trailers—your work will directly contribute to transforming lives at scale.


Core Responsibilities

  • Edit both long-form and short-form video content for online courses, YouTube, and social media platforms (Reels, TikTok, Shorts, Ads)
  • Incorporate transitions, motion graphics, sound design, color grading, and subtitles to create compelling content
  • Follow creative briefs while also bringing your own vision to elevate the final product


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with content creators, marketers, and instructional designers to align messaging and visuals
  • Ensure final assets meet brand guidelines and performance objectives


Strategy & Impact

  • Develop and maintain efficient post-production workflows using cloud-based tools
  • Use engagement and performance data to iterate and improve video effectiveness
  • Propose creative storytelling angles and visual treatments that enhance retention and impact


Expected Outcomes

You will be successful in this role when:

  • 90%+ of projects are delivered on time and exceed internal quality benchmarks
  • Videos meet or exceed performance goals across YouTube, Meta, social media, and internal platforms.
  • You’ve systematized editing workflows that increase output capacity by at least 30% within 90 days.


Requirements

  • 2–4+ years of professional experience in video editing for online businesses, influencers, educational platforms, or social media content
  • Proven ability to create high-impact content that performs well across social and direct-response platforms
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and basic audio/sound mastering tools
  • Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Experience with YouTube channel editing, motion graphic templates, or podcast video content
  • Experience creating VSLs and editing performance-driven ad creatives for Facebook Ads and YouTube Ads. 


Compensation

Base Salary: US$ 750 – US$ 2,000 /month + Performance bonus

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and performance.


Location

Remote-first

We operate asynchronously across global time zones. Work from wherever you thrive.


Benefits

  • Flexible PTO + Company-wide Holidays
  • Remote work culture with performance-based autonomy
  • Collaborate with high-performers and creative thinkers
  • Be part of a mission-driven company helping millions transform their lives


CelEducation Core Values

We believe great people are at the center of every successful business. The right candidate for this role will not only understand these values—but live them.


Competitive Greatness – Be at your best when your best is needed. Love the challenge.

Sincere Candor – Say the hard thing. Receive the hard thing. Feedback fuels growth.

Unimpeachable Character – Act with integrity. Think long-term. Be someone others trust.

Procuramos pessoas com boa capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e facilidade para lidar com múltiplas prioridades. Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar aplicações utilizando C# .NET, ASP.NET e Visual Studio.

Criar, analisar e otimizar consultas e procedimentos utilizando SQL Server e Oracle.

Atuar na manutenção de aplicações legadas em VB.NET e VB6 (diferencial).

Contribuir em projetos que envolvam ambientes em nuvem e on-premise.

Desenvolver interfaces e funcionalidades utilizando JavaScript, HTML, CSS e jQuery.

Realizar análise e resolução de problemas técnicos;

Elaborar soluções sustentáveis e alinhadas às boas práticas de engenharia de software.

Experiência com C# .NET, ASP.NET e Visual Studio;

Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL Server e Oracle;

Vivência com desenvolvimento front-end (JavaScript, HTML, CSS, jQuery);

Conhecimento em VB.NET e VB6 para manutenção de sistemas on-premise.

Remoto nas demais localidades.

Na LG lugar de gente, cuidamos de quem faz parte do nosso time. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios que apoia seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida:

  • Modelo de trabalho flexível;
  • Wellhub (descontos em academias e bem-estar);
  • Descontos em farmácias conveniadas;
  • Benefício Social Familiar com subsídio da empresa;
  • Day Off no mês do aniversário;
  • PIED – Programa interno de incentivo à educação (via processo seletivo);
  • Seguro de Vida em grupo;
  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e que valoriza a diversidade;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

Na LG lugar de gente, a gente acredita em você!

description:

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Analista de Projetos e Sistemas de TI Sênior

  • Sólido conhecimento em levantamento e detalhamento de requisitos.

  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio.

  • Proatividade e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos.

  • Remoto: Home office - 100%.


PJ - 30 dias de descanso remunerado

title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Java/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


We are seeking a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer  to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.


What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)  and Pair Programming  as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with Java/Spring Boot  on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with React  on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.


Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP):  Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning:  Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization:  Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown ARC  system.
  • Allocations:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown KOALA  system.


Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.


Essential Functions:

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” section.
  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.
  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.

description:

We are seeking a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer  to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.


What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)  and Pair Programming  as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with Java/Spring Boot  on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with React  on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.


Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP):  Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning:  Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization:  Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown ARC  system.
  • Allocations:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown KOALA  system.


Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry. Please apply only if you have worked in this field.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $12.50 - $18 USD hourly / $2,000 - $2,880 monthly (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Desenvolvedor Python Especialista
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de serviços , contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Ingles Fluente | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração:Dollar | Full-time


Requisitos Necessários

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, TI ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente)

Experiencia prática em desenvolvimento Fullstack com:

Proficiência em Python (Framework principal: Django, FastAPI, Graphql, ORM, Async programming, scripting e automação)

Experiência em microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos

Vivência com bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, etc.) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, ElasticSearch, etc.)

Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins JTE)

Vivência em AWS Cloud e serviços gerenciados (ECS, S3, Lambda, SQS, Amplify, etc.)

Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes

Capacidade de produzir código limpo e sustentável em prazos agressivos

Forte conhecimento em Git

Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Requisitos Desejáveis

Ter atuado como Tech Lead ou participado de iniciativas que exigiram liderança técnica.

Contato próximo com processos de produto, trabalhando em conjunto com Product Managers e equipes multidisciplinares.


Responsabilidades

Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações web baseadas em AWS Cloud utilizando Python

Escrever código limpo, escalável e eficiente, seguindo boas práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento

Colaborar com o time na definição de requisitos, escopo e objetivos do projeto

Construir e manter APIs RESTful para integração em backend

Garantir a qualidade do software por meio de testes abrangentes, depuração e troubleshooting

Defender e aplicar práticas de TDD (Test-Driven Development) e testes automatizados

Otimizar aplicações para performance, escalabilidade e segurança

Participar de code reviews, cerimônias ágeis e sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento

Acompanhar tendências de mercado e novas tecnologias para manter as soluções atualizadas

Fornecer suporte técnico e resolver incidentes relacionados a aplicações

title: Analista Fiscal Senior
description:
Descrição da Vaga


Principais pontos chaves de conhecimento:

  • Parametrização de Impostos em sistema ERP (Preferencialmente SAP)
  • Importação e Exportação (Análise de tributária conforme NCMs, emissão de DANFE para fins de desembaraço de mercadorias, tratamento fiscal da entrada de mercadorias no estoque)
  • Apuração de impostos indiretos (PIS, COFINS, IPI e ICMS)
  • Impostos retidos
  • REINF
  • PERD/COMP
  • FCI
  • Declarações (SPED fiscal, SPED contribuições)
  • Atendimento a auditoria externa


Responsável por todas as rotinas da área fiscal, garantindo a correta contabilização e recolhimento de tributos, além de assegurar o cumprimento das exigências fiscais e tributárias.


  • Analisar notas fiscais de entrada e saída, validando tributos e solicitando correções quando necessário;
  • Orientar fornecedores e equipe interna sobre o correto preenchimento de documentos fiscais;
  • Parametrizar o sistema para correta tributação de notas fiscais de entrada e saída;
  • Realizar faturamentos e controlar materiais em terceiros;
  • Cadastrar serviços tomados nos sites das prefeituras para correta tributação;
  • Monitorar intimações fiscais acessando sites de órgãos reguladores;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre a legislação fiscal para garantir conformidade;
  • Preparar relatórios e quadros demonstrativos sobre o desempenho da área;
  • Realizar conciliação fisco-contábil e apuração de tributos municipais, estaduais e federais;
  • Emitir guias de pagamento de impostos e providenciar documentação para comprovação aos órgãos públicos;
  • Emitir cartas de correção e segundas vias de documentos quando necessário;
  • Auxiliar no processo de contabilização, suporte na conciliação de contas e cadastramento de clientes, fornecedores e produtos;
  • Cadastrar contas contábeis de ativo e adiantamento a fornecedores;
  • Atender auditorias e fiscalizações, disponibilizando documentos e prestando esclarecimentos;


Escolaridade: Ensino Superior Completo em Ciências Contábeis.


Conhecimentos Técnicos

Experiência na área fiscal;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office.


Carteira de Benefícios

Assistência médica do plano de saúde Unimed, atendimento nível nacional.

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição, de R$ 40,00/dia.

Vale Transporte (6% desconto em folha) ou Auxílio Combustível, de R$ 150,00/mês.

Wellhub e parceria com a escola de idiomas inFlux.

Estacionamento próprio no condomínio da empresa.


Esta é uma vaga CLT, presencial na sede da empresa em Valinhos-SP.


OBS: CASO VOCÊ NÃO RESIDA PRÓXIMO A REGIÃO, INFELIZMENTE NO MOMENTO ESSA VAGA NÃO É APROPRIADA PARA VOCÊ, FAVOR NÃO SE CANDIDATAR, POIS OS CURRÍCULOS NÃO SERÃO AVALIADOS.

title: Propulsion Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage in close collaboration with stakeholders from various teams to gather in-depth insights into the requirements and objectives of the vehicle. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including electrical and software engineers to ensure seamless integration of the propulsion systems.
  • Propulsion System Development: Apply advanced engineering principles and methodologies to create propulsion solutions that are recognized for their reliability, efficiency, and high performance. Take the lead in chairing meetings with stakeholders, actively listen to their concerns, facilitate productive discussions, and collaborate towards resolving any issues collectively. Additionally, prepare and deliver comprehensive presentations to the leadership team, highlighting the significant progress and achievements attained during the propulsion system development process.

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming.

Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.


SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Remote

Must follow and support US time zones

Enterprise Architect


Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Economics, Sociology, or another related field.
  • 8+ years of IT experience required.
  • 4+ years of architecture experience in multiple architectural domains such as business, information, application, integration, technology, and security.
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations on technology strategies while considering various options and business needs.
  • Awareness of retail, supply chain, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries.
  • TOGAF, IASA or any other architecture-related certification is required.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


The Technical Architect provides the leadership, facilitation, analysis, and design tasks required for the development of an enterprise's technical architecture. They create deliverables that help develop target-state guidance (standards, guidelines, reference implementations) for evolving the technical infrastructure across the enterprise, to enable business strategy and deliver targeted business outcomes. They facilitate and orchestrate the delivery of targeted business outcomes through technical decisions.


  • Leads efforts to develop and maintain the architectural assets for the technical domain.
  • Sets an architecture direction for the technical domain that is aligned with business and IT goals.
  • Works with service management teams and solution architects to lower the total cost of ownership for IT capabilities.
  • Represents enterprise architecture by advocating and sharing knowledge.
  • Participates as a member of one or more architectural review boards (ARB) that ensure architecture quality and compliance.


  • Integration Architecture
  • Application Architecture
  • Technical Architecture
  • New Technology Innovation
  • Architecture Work
  • Modeling & Design:


Standard Setting:

  • Leads the creation of technical standards within area(s) of responsibility
  • Responsible for updating work products and communication when changes are required

description:

The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.

  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
